recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless the Extension Pack definition is lost or new work-group-approved guidance is targeted to the appropriate external source.
issue_request: FHIR-12217 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and asked how to represent a SNOMED Description Id alongside a Concept Id for an NHS requirement, with final resolution to add an extension.
initial_application: Historical commit e7180dea8444e0bc39f443e7306444ee80bb12c7 applied #12302 and #12217 together by adding the sctdescid Coding extension row and a SNOMED page reference.
additional_context: FHIR-12302 is the paired issue that explicitly requested the standard SNOMED Description ID extension. FHIR-core later removed the old extension row and no longer contains the live StructureDefinition; the current definition is in HL7/fhir-extensions. Later FHIR-33058 and FHIR-40724 broadened this same extension in the Extension Pack and have existing combined-branch audits.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit with no FHIR-core source changes because the approved extension is already present in the Extension Pack and restoring it to core would reverse the extension-pack migration.

related_jiras.note: Paired Published issue that requested defining the same SNOMED Description ID extension and referencing it from the SNOMED CT page.
Later Published issue broadened coding-sctdescid to designation contexts and is already audited on the combined branch.
Later Applied issue broadened coding-sctdescid to display contexts in the Extension Pack and is already audited on the combined branch.
Resolved No Change issue rejected a generic non-SNOMED description id extension.
